Marissa — thanks for flagging. Quick math: list $580k -> target $480k = $100k gap = 17.2%.

Approved levers: 1) Term extension (to 18 months) reduces ARR hit by 6-8% equivalent. 2) Implementation credit (one-time) up to $30k. 3) Performance-based kicker: additional 5% rebate if they convert to Production within 9 months.

If we combine (1) + (2) + (3) we can get to an effective economic similar to 15-17% without writing down recurring revenue. However per pricing policy anything >15% requires written finance sign-off (Naomi).

I've attached a short pricing workup (Pricing_Workup_Orion.xlsx) with scenarios. Recommend we offer: 15% off list (recurring), $25k implementation credit, 18-month term, 5% conversion rebate. That should be defensible in future comps and keeps contractual exposure reasonable.

Markus — any objections on territory/discount comp credit?

Rishi
Director, Enterprise Sales
